sources.label: Aura Partners AUDX Independent Limited Assurance Report - July 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The July 31, 2026 AUDX Reserve Verification Report records AUD 3,231,371.79 in designated TAU accounts against AUD 3,208,057.00 of AUDX in circulation. Aura Partners' independent limited-assurance report, dated August 20, 2026 and performed under ASAE 3000 and ASAE 3100, obtained independent confirmation of reserve balances directly from the relevant financial institution or institutions, inspected blockchain ledger data, and reconciled reserves to issued supply; its conclusion found no matter indicating that the supply was under-backed. Management states that all AUDX reserves are held in segregated, unencumbered accounts. The report does not name the financial institutions or disclose account-level allocation, so the single designated-bank-account category remains 100%.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Aura Partners independent limited assurance under ASAE 3000/3100 of the AUDX Reserve Verification Report as of July 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The report establishes that the full reserve is held in designated bank accounts, but does not name the financial institutions or disclose provider shares and deposit terms.
